entry_points.text: Boot registers failure controls and randomization control, prepares per-CPU queues, and offers a boot option forcing randomization off.

Fault installers validate mode exclusivity, bounds, permissions and cache attributes, accept frames or pages with zero-frame policy, install special entries reporting no-page, and map busy to benign, using ENOMEM EBUSY EFAULT EINVAL EACCES and NOPAGE OOM BUS.

exports.text: PFN space registry inserts and removes interval descriptors, requiring a translation hook, rejecting overlaps, and guarding the shared cached index with a dedicated mutex.

DAX failure path revokes extents with mandatory termination under mapping guards with RCU, marks poison except before removal, collects affected file mappings, reports busy when an entry cannot be secured, and leaves each offset unlocked.
Deferred failure submission queues a frame with flags and schedules local work; taken-off tags use page private storage; raw poison queries scan the folio list under the global mutex for huge cases.
Address-space globals provide a highest mappable frame watermark, a per-mm resource reporter, and a randomization switch defaulting on with a kernel control.

Teardown releases tables over floored intervals avoiding wrap confusion, detaches reverse mappings via maple cursor with coalescing, and batches file areas sharing one file in fixed arrays flushing on file change or full.
Kernel leaf allocation and table walking ensure middle levels exist, return the locked leaf entry, assert absence of huge leaves, and report allocation failure.

Fork duplicates ranges unless faults can rebuild, unmap clears spans with invalidation using flag bundles and notifier spans, reaping uses nonblocking invalidation with busy fallback, guarded clears require raw or mixed mode, and corrupt tops are skipped.

Insertion maps caller pages into areas under leaf locks in batches, promotes to mixed mode, covers whole areas from arrays with bounds and EFBIG checks, splits kernel prepare and complete, and releases tracking contexts with base, length and refcounts on drop.

hazards.text: Queue overflow drops newest reports; surplus references force failure; unknown states count as ignored; file recovery prefers filesystem hooks then invalidation, surfacing dirty errors to writers.

Sixteen-entry queue, three retries and six huge codes; vm holds memory_failure_early_kill, recovery, enable_soft_offline and panic_on_unrecoverable with five counters; outcomes Ignored Failed Delayed Recovered with ten page types; randomize_va_space under kernel; PT strings 33/17 chars; Unpoison/Soft offline prefixes.

invariants.text: Recovery and soft offline default on, early kill and panic off, poison count zero, global indicator false, and the poison filter hook starts absent under RCU.

Error table matches flags in order from huge through swap, mlocked, unevictable and LRU pairs to a final unknown entry; poisoned LRU detach clears reclaim state, and surplus refs are logged as failure.

Poison matching accepts present and encoded entries at mapping granularity with compound offsets; DAX collection records file addresses, considering all tasks before removal and selected tasks otherwise.
Release and copy walk coarse to fine, skipping empty or bad entries; zero means bottom as start and top as end; destination tables allocate on demand with huge-first attempt.

Present copies share by reference with separate anon and file accounting and COW write-protection; absent copies handle swap, migration and device kinds with exclusivity cleared; exclusive restore is nonblocking with busy signal.

Duplication is needed for COW-fork or anon state; zero-page insertion respects opt-out and writability avoiding long pins; validation rejects unreferenced, anon or typed pages; spans must lie inside areas and arrays must cover; huge fork delegates and walks assert no huge leaf.

Occupied leaves report busy unless upgrade matches frame then marks young; remap requires aligned starts, empty leaves, allowed frames and flushed caches under leaf locks; full coverage attaches a tracking context while partial only tunes attributes, clearing partial fills and skipping mismatches.

locks.text: Per-CPU queue insert, drain and scheduling hold per-CPU guards initialized at boot and route soft-offline to soft handling while table checks hold PT guards.

Kernel install guards emptiness recheck; file batch holds mapping write guard across one file then resets; range copy holds both leaf guards with nesting, lazy mode and bounded yields, with EIO growth retry, busy termination and prealloc retry, requiring exclusive address-space guarding.

state_machines.text: Recovery yields ignored, failed, delayed or recovered with clean leaning recovered and unknown ignored; table search via read-locked walk set covers huge and small ranges yielding at most one location with permissive PFN-map test.

Batched insertion fills bounded groups under one lock advancing on success and unwinding counts on failure; tracking attaches contexts on success or frees on failure; mixed insertion chooses frame or page paths mapping exhaustion to faults.

structs.text: Kill records hold task, address and shift size; walk context adds target frame and flags; dispatch descriptors pair masks with handlers; raw nodes link pages; per-CPU queues hold sixteen entries; per-node stats expose five read-only counters.
